source.note: Final candidate adds the scoped employee-creation first-use fix and the sample-workspace loader. Runtime batch 229 passed; product batch and clean-install first job rerun on this source.

configuration.backend: isolated SQLite worlds; local controlled OpenAI-compatible endpoints; no cloud credential or live provider
configuration.frontend: Next.js production build from clean checkout, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8071
configuration.install: git worktree at 42773f234; make setup (fresh backend venv + frontend npm install); empty data root; documented uvicorn bootstrap; real restart
configuration.first_use: clean-install world at 776c; make setup; empty data root; sample loader completed 232990.00 and a DOCX in 13 seconds after backend start

claims.title: delegation nesting depth
claims.result: 16 passed (fleet controls); full runtime batch 229 passed
claims.positive: wide shallow fleet accepted; max-depth chain allowed
claims.negative: depth 3 at max 2 refused; self/back/multi-parent cycle refused; new edge that deepens an existing descendant refused; cross-tenant and unknown parent refused; no link/count mutation on refusal

claims.title: single accountable agent
claims.result: 16 passed (fleet controls); full runtime batch 229 passed
claims.negative: zero, multiple and duplicate-list accountable contracts rejected before the link exists; validator reports the reason

claims.title: runtime revocation
claims.result: 12 passed (revocation + runtime calibration); full batch 229 passed
claims.positive: certified enable reaches the runtime gate; a verified regression revokes; 20 new verified successes re-earn
claims.negative: first failure without prior success is not a regression; one and 19 new successes remain blocked; restart and new sessions stay revoked; unreadable authority store fails closed; post-wait assignment resume requires explicit approval after revocation

claims.title: no-progress handling
claims.result: 10 passed (plus dedicated no-progress loop controls); full batch 229 passed
claims.positive: real GenericAgent loop halts before a third identical tool+args dispatch and records stuck_reason
claims.negative: different args do not halt; flag-off behavior unchanged; repeated identical observations inject a recorded strategy-change directive instead of spinning

claims.title: policy pause/resume
claims.result: 7 passed (payload drift, fresh engine and crash-after-dispatch included); full batch 229 passed
claims.positive: durable HITL approval resumes the same workflow and executes the critical step once; completed state survives a fresh engine
claims.negative: zero effects before approval; wrong execution/step/action refused; rejected or missing row refused; changed payload refused; crash-after-dispatch pauses for reconciliation and does not resend

claims.title: training lifecycle
claims.positive: supervisor POST /api/maturity/training/start creates a pending proposal; approval creates a persisted session with guidance; linked evidence completion promotes to INTERN
claims.negative: non-supervisor refused; duplicate approval/completion idempotent or refused; no evidence raises InsufficientTrainingEvidenceError and leaves the hire a STUDENT

claims.title: Settings credential lifecycle
claims.positive: save first key -> chat uses it; replace second key -> chat uses it; delete -> chat fails closed, all without process restart
claims.negative: deleted key is not resent; no key material appears in logs; third chat returns the truthful all-providers-failed message and makes no new provider call

claims.title: local OpenAI-compatible endpoint
claims.result: 2 passed (plus ROUTE-03 in the same run)
claims.positive: provider registered through POST /api/local-models + capabilities; first public chat and absolute fallback dispatch reach that controlled local endpoint with no cloud key
claims.negative: an unconfigured workspace dispatches nowhere and reports no provider; a registered but capability-less route is truthfully ineligible

claims.title: provider fallback
claims.positive: allowed primary fails (502), allowed secondary serves the recorded response; result provider is the secondary
claims.negative: policy-denied third endpoint receives zero calls; the test logs/asserts primary and secondary HTTP hits separately
claims.note: The scratch world's global pricing catalog is empty, so the test pins provider/model compatibility for the two isolated endpoints; policy, fallback order, real HTTP dispatch and provenance are not patched.

claims.title: D3 graph explorer
claims.result: verified; 3 nodes, 2 relationships, selected Atlas, 2 relationships rendered, zero page errors
claims.positive: real browser loads the explorer from the Next proxy/backend, renders populated nodes/edges, selects a node and shows incoming/outgoing relationships
claims.negative: empty graph, API-only route, or page error does not pass; the assertion requires real DOM nodes and a relationship list

claims.title: pristine bootstrap
claims.command: git worktree add <fresh> 42773f234; make setup; scripts/acceptance/readme_local_install.py --world <empty> --port 8137; npm run build
claims.result: setup exited 0; bootstrap password file 0600; login 200; durable task and workflow survive a real backend restart; production frontend build exited 0; final rerun at aba2754ec
claims.positive: fresh venv and node_modules from package manifests; generated .env has valid SECRET/JWT/Fernet keys; documented uvicorn bootstrap; real restart; browser login on the production build
claims.negative: no borrowed venv, PYTHONPATH overlay, absolute node_modules link, or pre-existing data root was used; the clean worktree has its own backend/venv and node_modules

claims.title: OIDC lifecycle
claims.positive: real controlled local IdP: config round-trip, redirect with state/nonce, callback token exchange, verified ID-token claims, application session
claims.negative: bad state, replay, invalid signature/issuer/audience/nonce, missing token, token failure, callback error, disallowed domain and discovery mismatch all refused
